recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Any future LOINC method-part support should be a new terminology design decision, not a restoration of the old pseudo-property filter.
issue_request: FHIR-8399 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 change request for FHIR-core Observation noting that the observation-methods value set included a LOINC filter Type = METHOD_TYP that did not conform to LOINC guidance or the actual LOINC database.
initial_application: Commit f16ff276ebde2a99c3ef4bd03b9e020f89144335, matching the Jira svn revision 6634 comment, applied the issue by removing the LOINC include from source/observation/valueset-observation-methods.xml rather than preserving and documenting the pseudo-property filter.
additional_context: FHIR-8399 directly followed the same Observation Methods LOINC-filter trail as FHIR-5600. The current value set has since evolved to SNOMED CT filters only, while Observation remains active and Observation.method binds to this value set.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already lacks the invalid LOINC include and Type = METHOD_TYP filter.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue corrected the same old Observation Methods LOINC filter before FHIR-8399 removed the include.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue reporting that the observation-methods LOINC filter Type = METHOD_TYP was invalid.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes a final same-artifact decision that the remaining LOINC filter needed correction.
